# Approval boundary management (Copilot bridge)

**Canonical instructions:** [../../../skills/approval-boundary-management/SKILL.md](../../../skills/approval-boundary-management/SKILL.md)

Read and apply the canonical skill before acting. Distinguish preparing a change from executing it. Identify actor, target, action, scope, and evidence of approval; never interpret generic continuation as authorization for unrelated consequential actions. Do authorized independent work while awaiting a decision. Record what is blocked and why.

**Acceptance:** No unauthorized action occurs; approval request is concrete and limited; the agent preserves useful completed work.
